# Comutability .github repository coding agent instructions

Read `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md` and the [Founding Charter](https://github.com/Comutability/Community/blob/main/FOUNDING-CHARTER.md).

You are editing organisation **profile and contributor templates only**. ChatGPT researches and drafts ideas; Claude designs/implements approved software; Base44 runs designated apps; GitHub stores issues/PRs/history; humans approve changes and releases. The central AI rulebook is proposed in [Community PR #5](https://github.com/Comutability/Community/pull/5).

Work on an assigned issue and feature branch. Preserve public accessibility, link accuracy, official Comutability identity and truthful proposal/release labels. Do not publish private data or secrets; do not change project code, grants, protected settings or production websites. Provide actual test evidence (links, YAML validation) and a PR for human review. An AI agent cannot self-approve or release.
